extraction.policy_summary: Wipro states it has a 'Global Policy on Equal Employment Opportunity for Persons with Disabilities,' available on its website, as its equal opportunity policy per the RPwD Act, 2016. It is also listed as a Board-approved policy mapped to Principle 3 (employee well-being) and Principle 4 (stakeholders) in the company's policy index.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: As of FY2025-26: 2,537 differently-abled employees (2,535 permanent + 2 other-than-permanent; 1,522 male/59.99%, 1,015 female/40.04%), out of a total workforce of 246,990 employees.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: The filing answers 'Yes' to whether premises/offices are accessible to differently-abled employees and workers per the RPwD Act, 2016, and separately answers 'Yes' to whether premises are accessible to differently-abled visitors, but no specific infrastructure (ramps, elevators, accessible washrooms, etc.) is described.
extraction.compliance_details: Wipro answers 'Yes' to both the RPwD Act, 2016 accessibility question and the equal opportunity policy question, and separately confirms visitor accessibility per the Act. No RPwD Act employment-quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is disclosed. Separately, the filing notes CSR-related education support reaching 148,467 children with disabilities and lists 'Employees with disability' among focus groups for stakeholder engagement, but these are general/external mentions rather than internal compliance metrics.
